name: Odds-API.io - Real-Time Sports Betting Odds API (v3)
description:
Odds-API.io is a powerful sports betting odds comparison API, providing real-time data from 450+ bookmakers across 34 sports with near zero latency.

- 450+ bookmakers supported
- 34 sports including Football, Basketball, Tennis, Esports and more
- Real-time odds with close to zero latency
- Pre-match & In-play odds coverage
- 99.9% uptime for reliability
